translations.web: I will signal for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them; and they will increase as they have increased.
translations.bsb: I will whistle for them to gather, for I have redeemed them; and they will be as numerous as they once were.
translations.kjv: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
